name: stateful-button

frames.best_why: The button shows a white spinner beside Submit inside its hover ring, capturing the busy state.

tagline: A green pill that swaps in a spinner, then a tick, after a click.
summary: A rounded green submit button that spins up a loader while its click handler runs, then flashes a circled tick before settling back to its normal label.
appearance: A wide bright-green pill with bold white 'Submit' centred on near-black. On hover a second green ring appears around it; while busy a white spinner sits just before the words.
behaviour: Clicking grows a small spinning arc beside the label, holds the button in place during the async work, then swaps the arc for a circled tick for two seconds before returning to the plain state.
demo_content: The button is labelled 'Submit' and fakes a one and a half second save.
search_phrases: submit button with a loading spinner
button that shows a tick when done
save button that spins then confirms
use_when: A form submit or save action needs to show progress and confirm success in the same spot.
avoid_when: The green fill and two-second tick are fixed, so it takes a source edit to match another palette.
customise: The label comes as children and button attributes pass through, with className for size and colour; loader timing and the two-second success hold are in the source.
weight_why: One button with short icon animations and a spinner only while busy.

a11y.note: The busy and success states are not announced; only the icons change, with no aria-busy or live region.

issues: The success tick is faint white-on-green and easy to miss without watching the click.
polish_why: Clean, obvious states; the success tick is low contrast and the demo is one lonely button.
title: Stateful Button
